summary: Read two strings that have the same length. Judge whether characters in the first string can be replaced to produce the second. Every occurrence of one character must turn into the same character, and two different characters must not turn into one shared character. A character may turn into itself. Replacement keeps the order of positions. Write true when such a replacement exists and write false otherwise. Equal length is given. Characters correspond by position, so you cannot shuffle either string before matching.
notes: The left column is this sample's input text and the right column is the text the program should print. Comparison ignores trailing newlines.
